answer_1.quote: Although abstractive summarization systems have improved dramatically in recent years, these models still often include factual errors in generated summaries.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate several SOTA factual consistency metrics on our benchmark, namely DAE, QuestEval, SummaC-ZS, SummaC-Conv and QAFactEval.

answer_3.quote: ChatGPT-ZS and ChatGPT-CoT prompt LLMs to directly output a binary factuality decision. On the other hand, ChatGPT-DA and ChatGPT-Star ask LLMs to score the factuality of generated summaries on a scale of 0-100 and 1-5 respectively.

answer_4.quote: All datasets contain summaries generated from articles in CNN/DM and XSum. ... The binary factuality labels for the summaries are determined by human evaluations on the annotated datasets (Section 2.2).
answer_4.guideline: human evaluations of Factual consistency on model generated summaries
